name: OpenDots
one_liner: An open-source template for always-on AI coworkers that each have their own computer and work across text, calls and Slack (alpha).

text.why: Using an AI agent usually means briefing a chat window every time. OpenDots is a starting point for Dots with their own role, permissions and computer, whose work lands as pages you can keep editing.
text.take: It shows an ask, browse, approve, save flow inside one chat.
build: Built with CopilotKit and AG-UI: Spaces for working documents, a live view of the agent's computer in chat, and human review cards, on web and mobile. You clone it and run it yourself.

who.role: Developers who want to build their own agent workspace.

start.text: Clone the repository and follow the Setup guide to connect your services.

caveat: The README says it is a template, not a hosted product, and in early development; you configure the infrastructure and connected services yourself.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
